newsitem.title: USA: France Telecom signs $470 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom signs $470 mln contract.

text.p: France Telecom said Wednesday it signed a business cooperation contract with the Vietnamese Post and Telecommunications carrier VNPT as part of Vietnam's program to develop its telecommunications networks.
The contract, which amounts to about $470 million, covers the installation of 540,000 telephone lines during a five-year period in the Ho Chi Minh province and includes revenue sharing for 15 years.
It said the Vietnamese government should sign "shortly" the license required to start operations.
The contract focuses on financing and installing 540,000 new lines, which doubles the current number, and on helping manage the Vietnamese carrier through on-site experts and training programs.
